WITH phase_stats AS (
  SELECT
    o.lunarstage,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS phase_avg,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.observstation) AS distinct_count
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  WHERE t.bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(phase_avg) AS mean_val
  FROM phase_stats
),
kept AS (
  SELECT 
    ps.phase_avg,
    ps.distinct_count,
    ps.phase_avg - om.mean_val AS excess
  FROM phase_stats ps
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
  WHERE ps.phase_avg > om.mean_val
)
SELECT
  AVG(k.phase_avg) AS avg_phase_averages,
  SUM(k.distinct_count) AS total_distinct_stations,
  AVG(k.excess) AS avg_excess
FROM kept k
